profile.headline: Technical Manager, Principal Software Engineer, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Architect, Agentic AI, Quantitative Finance.
profile.summary:
Technology leader with experience building scalable data, analytics, and AI-driven platforms in investment management.
 
I lead engineering teams at the intersection of data, quantitative research, and software to transform complex datasets—including alternative data—into actionable investment insights. My recent focus is on applying AI and large language models (LLMs) to accelerate data discovery, enhance analytics workflows, and improve decision-making for portfolio managers and analysts.
 
Experienced in designing end-to-end data platforms, factor modeling systems, and cloud-native architectures using Python, SQL, Snowflake, and AWS. Proven track record of delivering high-impact solutions, driving engineering excellence, and aligning technology strategy with business outcomes.
 
AWS Certified. Continuously advancing expertise in AI/ML and modern data systems.
